1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. The heavens are recounting the glory of God, and the firmament is declaring the work of and His hands.

2.w: Day after day it pours forth speech, and night after night it shows forth knowledge.

3.w: Without speech and without words, their voice not being heard,

4.w: their voice has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. He has placed a tent in them for the sun,

5.w: and it [is] like a bridegroom going forth from his chamber, rejoicing like a strong man to run the path.

6.w: From one end of the heavens [is] his going forth, and his circuit [is] upon their ends, and there is nothing being hidden from his heat.

7.w: The law of YHWH [is] perfect, refreshing the soul; the testimony of YHWH [is] sure, making wise the simple.

8.w: The statutes of YHWH [are] straight, making glad the heart; the commandment of YHWH [is] pure, bringing light to the eyes.

9.w: The fear of YHWH is pure, standing forever; the judgments of YHWH [are] true, being righteous altogether,

10.w: being desired above gold, and much above pure gold, and sweeter than honey and flowing honey from the honeycomb.

11.w: Indeed, Your servant is warned by them; in keeping them [is] great reward.

12.w: Who can discern [his] errors? From the hidden cleanse me.

13.w: Also, hold back Your servant from proud [things]; may they not rule over me. Then I shall be complete, and cleansed of great transgression.

14.w: The words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart, let them be for favor before Your face, O YHWH, my Rock and my Redeemer.
